canonical_project: Reliance Industries Giga-Scale AI Data Centre and Cable Landing Station, Bhogapuram
notes: AP approved allotment of ~854.97 acres in Vizianagaram district (Bhogapuram/Denkada area) to Reliance Industries for a giga-scale AI data centre and cable landing station; ~Rs 1.08 lakh crore proposed investment under AP DC Policy 4.0 incentives. Capacity not disclosed; land-allotted stage.
